desc: Add host-only regression coverage for the staged SD-root shutdown pivot before ticket 216 runs. Grounding: NEXT_STEPS §2, ROADMAP §H, and ticket 216's requirement that ext4 unmount, the loop detach, and exFAT unmount before the final power action. Exercise the current scripts with mocked mount/loop/service commands and inject a failure at every phase; assert that no path reports PASS while either filesystem remains mounted, that sync and identity gates precede mutation, and that the check-only postcondition is requested only after detach/unmount. Deliver tests, expected traces, and an evidence note. No fixture access, filesystem mutation, enrollment, or rig lease.
author: sol
